outlook.statement: Despite the decline in revenue, the Board of Directors remains confident about the Company's future prospects and is optimistic about achieving sustainable growth in the coming years. The Company continues to focus on strengthening its business operations, improving operational efficiency, leveraging technological advancements and exploring new business opportunities with a view to enhancing its financial performance and delivering improved results in the years ahead.

The outlook for the Company will depend upon developments in the Indian economy, financial markets, interest rates, availability of funding, asset quality and the overall regulatory environment. The management will continue to focus on prudent lending and investment decisions, effective recovery and monitoring of exposures, appropriate management of liquidity and borrowings, cost optimisation and regulatory compliance.
